children: Australian shares were expected to open flat on Tuesday as surging oil prices fan inflationary concerns and amplify risk-off sentiment among investors, while gains in heavyweight miners could limit losses in gold stocks on higher base metal prices.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) marginally fell 0.01%, a 15.9-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark rose 0.1% on Monday.
